column4: All inbound traffic is being diverted to Nandino Blvd due to a serious collision involving a pedestrian at Mercer Road.  Police are directing traffic at the Nandino Blvd intersection.
Traffic from Nandino Blvd is being directed northbound onto Georgetown Road.
Note:  Outbound traffic on Georgetown Road will be delayed due to inbound traffic being detoured.  Also expect delays on Nandino Blvd.
Outbound Georgetown Road at Citation Blvd
